name: DATASONIC
recent: SC 正检视 NexG 股票交易异常波动。同时，执行主席 Dato' Haji Ishak 在闭市期内外通过关联公司及女儿多次买卖公司股份，并有一名董事辞任。最新季度财报显示营收同比大幅下滑且录得净亏损。
notable: SC 正在检视 NexG 股票交易。
执行主席 Dato' Haji Ishak 通过 Skyelimit Alliance 在公开市场增持 1,968,300 股。
公司有一名董事 Mohamad Tirmizi bin Ishak 辞任。
risks: SC 正在检视 NexG 股票交易异常波动。
执行主席关联方在闭市期内多次买卖公司股份，包括增持与减持。
最新季度营收同比下滑 44.3%，净亏损同比扩大 104.4%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 49.24m，同比下滑 44.3%，环比下滑 52.3%；净亏损 MYR 2.82m，净利率 -5.7%，较去年同期的 -36.5% 有所收窄，但净亏损同比扩大 104.4%。

recent_en: Datasonic has been in focus over NexG's proposed acquisition of its MyKad and passport unit, with the SC reviewing unusual trading in NexG shares. Meanwhile, Executive Chairman Dato' Haji Ishak and his associates traded shares during the closed period, and a boardroom change occurred. The latest quarterly results showed a sharp revenue decline and a net loss.
notable_en: SC is reviewing NexG share trading amid a RM7.5b takeover proposal involving Datasonic's MyKad and passport unit.
Executive Chairman Dato' Haji Ishak acquired 1,968,300 shares via Skyelimit Alliance in the open market.
Boardroom change: Encik Mohamad Tirmizi bin Ishak ceased to be a director.
risks_en: SC is examining unusual trading in NexG shares linked to the proposed acquisition of Datasonic's assets.
The Executive Chairman's associates traded shares during the closed period, including both acquisitions and disposals.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 44.3% YoY and net loss widened 104.4% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 49.24m, down 44.3% YoY and 52.3% QoQ; net loss was MYR 2.82m with a net margin of -5.7%, improved from -36.5% a year earlier, though net loss widened 104.4% YoY.
